description: Figure 3 exact 0.5 point-mass, reset-source, point-excluded middle-mass, and inactive-U-row audit for ten GaWF seeds.
notes: The analysis reads the registered Figure 6 copies of all ten retained Figure 3 trajectories directly on sjc-remote; numeric files were not synchronized locally.
The half-mass criterion is abs(g - 0.5) < 1e-6; inactive destination rows use max_r abs(U[j,r]) < 1e-6.
All dense gates are reconstructed and counted in float32 on GPU but are never saved.
The completed JSON contains ten per-seed records and seed-level mean with 95% Student-t confidence intervals.
